name: orc_r113_turbine_outlet_temperature
title: R113 ORC turbine outlet temperature (example)
summary: Teaching example for an R113 ORC turbine. The inlet is 150 kPa and 65 °C, the isentropic efficiency is 0.89 and the enthalpy drop is 17.5 kJ/kg. The model computes the turbine outlet temperature.
